rv.q: See From the Mississippi Delta and be transported by these three magnificent voices.
Ida Mae's story, narrated and enacted by three incredibly gifted actresses, is filled with both heartache and hilarity.
It is a weighty though rewarding journey from start to finish.
They make this show one that demands to be seen.

cn.t: Critics praise this funny yet poignant true story of Dr. Endesha Ida Mae Holland's journey from poverty to protest, with reviewers highlighting the production's ability to balance delight with gravity in depicting difficult material.
